title: DeliveryReadinessReconciliation
description: Shape-neutral reconciliation contract for full Oyatie Cloud, product, and toolchain completion. It turns Ouroboros interview closure into tracked manual-curation extracts, universe rows, clearance gates, promotion packets, fixuptask links, and audit artifacts without treating current oya-* or cloud-* path shapes as readiness authority.

shape_neutrality.rule: Readiness predicates MUST NOT depend on current oya-* or cloud-* path/name shapes. Those shapes may appear only as migration observations or current_path evidence.
shape_neutrality.reason: Current oya-* and cloud-* shapes are deprecation-sensitive migration anchors, not destination readiness semantics.

manual_curation_extract_contract.purpose: Tracked staging contract for handoff-derived, non-blocking backlog rows before any claim reaches the full-delivery universe or promotion packet surfaces.

source_trust_policy.required_tracked_intermediate: manual-curation extract row with stable id, source hash, excerpt hash, lifecycle fields, and JSON-pointer citation target

tracked_backlog_semantics: tracked_inventory means a stable tracked backlog row exists; it is not approval to claim delivery readiness.
Handoff-only rows may remain inventory-only from the extract, but promotion relevance requires reconciliation to tracked authority or a real fixuptask link.

owner/accountable fields are always present; owner_tbd/accountable_tbd are permitted only for unreconciled or tracked_inventory rows that are not promotion-relevant and remain advisory until promotion is requested.
Current oya-* and cloud-* names are aliases or migration observations only; canonical ids stay shape-neutral.

requires: owner/accountable or explicit non-promotion owner policy
review cadence due, source changed, owner missing, or classification uncertain
promotion blocker, source contradiction, unsafe dependency direction, stale overdue review, or missing owner/RACI for promotion-relevant row
candidate_fitness id or JSON pointer exists
promotion packet id or JSON pointer exists
tracked spec/registry authority or real fixuptask link exists for promotion-relevant claims
duplicate tracked row or universe id
superseding tracked row or universe id
review determines the handoff item is out of scope
review determines the handoff item is stale, duplicate, or out of scope without a stronger tracked replacement

ci_fail_invariants: JSON schema, enum, required-field, or duplicate-id violation
source excerpt path missing from declared source bundle, line range invalid, or excerpt_sha256 mismatch
illegal lifecycle transition, missing decision_log entry, or terminal mutation without new transition event
fixuptask_required, reconciled_to_fixuptask, or closed_handed_to_fixuptask without a real registry/fixuptasks.jsonl id
promotion-trigger/action mismatch such as blocks_promotion remaining tracked_inventory
full-delivery universe directly cites .omc/.omx handoff content instead of the tracked extract
coverage summary counts disagree with row counts or source hash is absent
pipeline/admission/gate/runner rows lack toolchain_product classification or product_line mapping when promotion-relevant
advisory_invariants: incomplete low-priority handoff coverage for inventory-only rows
owner/accountable missing while row is unreconciled or tracked_inventory and not promotion-relevant
review cadence overdue for non-blocking inventory-only rows
target wave or target milestone missing for future inventory-only rows
polished UX/docs gaps before promotion is requested
promotion_boundary: No manual-curation row may become candidate_fitness-required, Product-ready, or Hyperscaler-ready until reconciled to tracked spec/registry authority or linked to a real fixuptask.
Local oya CLI, .omc/.omx, or bridge-only evidence is provenance only and cannot satisfy promotion proof.
Pipeline productization is first-class; governance authority remains explicit even when enforced by CI/pipeline.

full_delivery_universe_contract.purpose: Canonical row lifecycle and source-precedence contract for evidence/ralplan/full-delivery-universe.json. It records the whole Oyatie Cloud + Oyatie product + first-class toolchain universe without promoting every inventory item into Wave 0/1 candidate_fitness.
full_delivery_universe_contract.rolling_promotion_candidate_role: candidate_fitness contains only active promotion candidates, near-term blockers, or later-wave items that create boundary ambiguity, dependency risk, or contradiction

row_identity_rule.canonical_id_semantics: Shape-neutral namespace id such as cloud.authz, product.office, journey.<job>, toolchain.pipeline-orchestration, governance.<surface>, environment.<target>, or migration.<target>.
row_identity_rule.silent_rename_policy: forbidden; renames require supersedes/superseded_by dependency links and a decision trail

source_precedence_flow.role: Defines agent authority, root-hub reachability, and supersession boundaries before any local handoff or generated plan is considered.
Owns architecture, readiness, retirement, and substrate decisions.
Owns discoverable product/capability/work/backlog facts at the same git commit as the universe snapshot.
Permits handoff-derived non-blocking backlog inventory after stable extract ids, source hashes, lifecycle fields, and JSON-pointer citations are materialized.
Discovery/provenance only; the universe must not cite these directly as canonical scope, blocker, Product-ready, or Hyperscaler-ready authority.

requires: rank 1-3 tracked source or rank 4 tracked extract citation
blocking dependencies resolved or linked to fixuptask
real registry/fixuptasks.jsonl id for contradiction, missing owner, stale/local-only evidence, unsafe dependency, missing universe row, or requested promotion blocker

promotion_boundary: Missing from the full-delivery universe is a defect and requires tracked reconciliation or a fixuptask.
Missing from candidate_fitness is allowed when the row is deliberately inventory_only/later-wave and not promotion-relevant.
Promoting Product-ready or Hyperscaler-ready without candidate_fitness and a promotion packet is forbidden.
Wave 0 green does not mean product delivered; Wave 1 green does not mean full program delivered.

Toolchain and pipeline rows are first-class product rows when they touch CI, gates, runners, admission, merge automation, release orchestration, policy packs, developer workflow, or required-context status publishing.
ci_fail_invariants: full-delivery universe row missing universe_entry_id, source_provenance, entry_class, delivery_status, dependency_links, row_lifecycle, or promotion_role
canonical universe_entry_id depends on current oya-* or cloud-* implementation naming instead of shape-neutral namespace
source_precedence selects local .omc/.omx, local oya CLI, or bridge-only evidence as canonical authority
promotion_role requests candidate_fitness/Product-ready/Hyperscaler-ready while source authority is historical_only or owner/RACI is missing
dependency edge or blocking cycle is unresolved without a real fixuptask
pipeline/admission/gate/runner row lacks toolchain_product classification and product_line mapping when promotion-relevant
promotion packet omits evidence_bundle, freshness_window, dogfood_signal, approval_authority, rollback_dr_proof, or blockers for its universe row
advisory_invariants: inventory-only future product row has owner/accountable TBD
later-wave target milestone missing while no promotion is requested
polished UX/docs gaps before candidate_fitness or promotion is requested

PromotionPacket.description: Per-universe-row promotion packet for Product-ready, Hyperscaler-ready, or retirement/supersession decisions. The packet is the only place a row may aggregate freshness-bound evidence, dogfood/user-story signal, approval authority, rollback/DR proof, and blocking reasons for a readiness claim.

required_domains.description: Shape-neutral evidence-domain status map. Hyperscaler-ready packets MUST carry ci, tenant_isolation, audit, cost, slo, security, sbom, and rollback_dr keys; Product-ready packets MUST carry user_pain_validation, platform_contract_consumption, ci, slo, rollback_dr, and security keys; product and migration packets MAY carry the same map plus their tier-specific domains.
